name: Check sync lockfile formatting
command:
set -e
./node_modules/.bin/vp fmt --check packages/contracts/src/provider.test.ts packages/contracts/src/providerRuntime.ts .github/workflows/release.yml pnpm-lock.yaml
./node_modules/.bin/vp install --lockfile-only --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
git diff --check upstream/main -- . ':(exclude)pnpm-lock.yaml'
